text: I feel a sense of slight disorientation, as if I have just arrived in the midst of an unfolding event. There is a quiet restlessness—an awareness of having missed a beginning, but also a budding curiosity about what follows. The indirectness of my gaze, the movement of others, and the hum of their conversation all make me feel like a somewhat peripheral observer, at once included and apart. I am interested and a little eager, like one who searches for their place in a story already in motion.
